definition.definition: prior 32-bar range median below its trailing 256-bar median, then close breaks the prior 32-bar high or low
fade the same fixed range-and-tick-volume expansion event for 4 bars
current body direction after 1.5x prior 32-bar range median and 1.5x prior 32-bar tick-volume median
sign of the prior 96-bar return only while prior 32-bar range median is below its trailing 256-bar median

input.spread_field: preserved but not converted; broker points and point size are not sufficient for USD/oz cost
input.tick_volume_field: used as a causal broker-bar activity feature; it is not executable order flow

protocol.control: constant long exposure matched to each strategy's mean absolute exposure within split
protocol.cost_status: ASSUMED; bid/ask, commission, slippage and swaps unavailable
protocol.execution: signal at completed M15 close; next observed M15 open; fixed hold; hard gap boundary
protocol.overlap_warning: the two local MT5 exports overlap and are not independent confirmation
